# LabLayout

> Offline, single-file app for labs, shops and tool cribs. You lay out one or more rooms (feet or metric), place benches, cabinets and machines, then switch to Inventory mode to track what's in every drawer. Each room can also be exported as a standalone tracker.

AI agents can generate layouts as JSON specs:

- Spec format, rules and library kinds: [AI_LAYOUT_GUIDE.md](AI_LAYOUT_GUIDE.md)
- Load a spec: open `builder.html#layout=<base64url JSON>`, or call `window.LabLayout.importSpec(spec)` on the builder page
- Check before loading: `window.LabLayout.validate(spec)`; read the current room: `window.LabLayout.exportSpec()`
- Units: feet for the room and positions, inches for furniture fronts and cells; origin at the top-left

## Files

- [builder.html](builder.html): the ready-to-open builder
- [README.md](README.md): features and setup
